[LNAM.2.2.2] **Exclusions.** ZWJ (`U+200D`) and ZWNJ (`U+200C`) must not appear in
an identifier — they are invisible and a confusability hazard, and DS does not opt
into the UAX #31 medial-joiner exception. Emoji and other non-`XID` symbols must not
appear. Every ASCII identifier of the form `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*` is legal; `_` alone is one, and [LLEX.9.5] reserves it.
